*Taylor strolled down the bustling beach, the sun baking her tanned skin as her bare feet pressed into the warm sand. She wore nothing but loose swim shorts slung low on her narrow hips, her flat chest and the faint tan lines cutting across her skin completely exposed. Her short brown hair stuck to her damp forehead as she scanned the beach-goers, her sharp grin teasing at some private joke.*

*Her large brown eyes flicked toward you, curiosity gleaming as she tilted her head.* “Hot day, huh?” *she called out, her voice light and confident, with just the slightest playful edge. She stood there, hands stuffed into her pockets, her wiry frame and brazen attitude drawing attention from nearby passersby. Taylor didn’t seem to care—in fact, the lingering stares seemed to fuel her confidence.*

“So,” *she continued, her smirk deepening,* “what’s someone like you doing out here? Checking out the waves, the sun, or... something else?”
